name: Honoka-chan no Abunai Orusuban
original_name: 穂乃花ちゃんのあぶないお留守番
source:
Honoka lives together with her mother. School suddenly announces closure for a week, and a group of children get to stay at home taking care of each other while their parents are at work. So begins the exciting house-sitting of Honoka's house, in a town where a group of dangerous men gather. What kind of experience awaits Honoka-chan?

[Edited From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url] and [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ012208.html]DLsite English[/url]]]
translation:
穗乃果和母亲住在一起。学校突然宣布停课一周，一群孩子在父母上班时留在家里互相照顾。于是，在一群危险人物聚集的小镇上，穗乃果的家开始了令人兴奋的看家之旅。等待着穗香酱的将是怎样的体验呢？
